title: Atlas DataFlow Dataset Discovery Evidence
description: Governed discovery evidence for a dataset. Records objective observations only: dataset metadata, per-field schema and type observations, null counts, cardinality, sample bounds, duplicated rows, and candidate categorical and target column fields. Candidate target columns must be flagged non-authoritative. Raw dataset content, raw logs, raw runtime data, raw API payloads, and secrets are prohibited. This schema does not authorize contract promotion, model training, or release publication.

schema_version.description: Schema version for this dataset discovery evidence document.

producer.description: Pipeline component that produced this discovery evidence.

dataset_metadata.description: Reduced dataset identity. Must not embed raw dataset contents or private absolute paths.

name.description: Dataset name derived from the source file stem.

row_count.description: Total number of rows in the dataset.

column_count.description: Total number of columns in the dataset.

source_path.description: Reduced source path reference. Must not contain private absolute path details or raw content.

source_fingerprint.description: Optional portable content fingerprint of the exact input consulted, independent of source_path. Absent in schema_version dataset-discovery-evidence.v1 evidence generated before this field existed; a new capability profile must never make this universally mandatory.

field_observations.description: Per-field objective observations. Must not embed raw field values or raw dataset content.

inferred_type.description: Inferred data type from non-null values.

null_count.description: Count of null or empty values in this field.

null_rate.description: Fraction of null or empty values over total rows.

sample_min.description: Minimum observed value (typed). Null when no non-null values exist.

sample_max.description: Maximum observed value (typed). Null when no non-null values exist.

duplicated_rows_count.description: Count of rows that are exact duplicates of another row (excess copies).

candidate_categorical_fields.description: Field names identified as candidate categorical fields based on cardinality. Non-authoritative — requires human review before finalization.

candidate_identifier_fields.description: Optional field names observed as candidate identifier fields (e.g. near-unique cardinality). Non-authoritative -- requires human review before finalization. Absent in evidence generated before this field existed.

candidate_target_columns.description: Candidate target column identifications. Each entry must be flagged non-authoritative. No automatic selection is performed. Applicability of a target is capability-profile-driven downstream; this array may legitimately be empty for a capability that forbids target semantics, and this schema never makes it universally mandatory.

is_authoritative.description: Must always be false. Candidate target columns require human review or a later authorized stage before finalization.

candidate_reason.description: Short non-authoritative reason for the candidate classification.

observed_shape.description: Optional observed shape of this candidate target column, independent of any authored target semantics.

observed_value_sample.description: Small, non-authoritative sample of observed distinct values.

drift_assertions.description: Optional drift-sensitive assertions this evidence generation observed relative to a prior generation for the same logical source, e.g. cardinality or null-rate stability. Absent in evidence generated before this field existed.

held.description: Whether this drift assertion held for this generation.

authoring_generation_ref.description: Optional traceability reference to the dataset-integration authoring generation that consumed this evidence, if any. Never authoritative for this evidence's own observations.

generation_settings.description: Settings that determine the evidence generation run. Same input and seed must produce identical observations.

seed.description: Determinism seed for sampling and statistical operations.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this evidence was generated.

discovery_boundary_confirmations.description: Explicit confirmation that discovery evidence generation did not perform forbidden operations.

contract_promotion_occurred.description: Discovery evidence must never perform or claim contract promotion.

model_training_occurred.description: Discovery evidence must never perform or claim model training.

release_publication_occurred.description: Discovery evidence must never perform or claim release publication.

evidence_policy.description: Safety policy for discovery evidence. All flags are required and fixed. Mirrors the pipeline evidence_policy convention.
